summary: Primal Scream Club is a drop-in wellness program run by Buncombe County Public Libraries (West Asheville Library, librarian Erin Parcels), now hosted monthly on New Belgium Brewing's river deck. It began as a one-time Helene-anniversary healing gathering in September 2025 and became a recurring library program; listings explicitly say 'no registration required, just show up,' with no membership structure, dues, or sign-up mentioned.

evidence.note: Listing describes it as 'the library's Primal Scream Club,' drop-in with 'no registration required, just show up,' and says the library brings a different community partner each session to showcase mental health resources.
All 5 listings are essentially identical monthly copy with no language about members, a roster, or named regulars returning.

BPR reports the club was founded and is run by West Asheville Library staff (librarian Erin Parcels), inspired by Scream Club Chicago; inaugural gathering drew ~75 people with no mention of a persistent membership community.
Buncombe County Public Libraries' own event calendar lists it as a library program, confirming it is library-organized rather than a self-run club.

Also picked up by the NC Governor's WNC Recovery Office as a Helene-recovery mental-health event, reinforcing it is framed as a public service program rather than a club with an identity-bearing membership.
